description: An oil-style painting of an outdoor garden with rows of folding chairs on grass, and a dark wooden desk in the foreground. On the desk are an open dark leather folder with a cream paper bearing cursive handwriting, a gold pen, and a small framed dark portrait of a man in a suit with one hand raised at a podium. The scene is dim and the trees and hedges are blurred. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
